products.name: Casio AE-1200WHL-5AV Brown Leather World Time Digital Watch
products.label: 7 in stock
products.desc: The Casio AE-1200WHL-5AV brings the signature multi-display World Time design together with a brown genuine-leather band. Its digital display shows home time at a glance, while the world map display helps track time across 31 time zones and 48 cities. Features include a 1/100-second stopwatch, countdown timer, five daily or one-time alarms, amber LED illumination, full auto-calendar through 2099 and 12/24-hour time format. The resin case measures 45 × 42.1 × 12.5 mm and weighs 39 g. Powered by a CR2025 battery with an approximate 10-year battery life. Water resistance: 100 metres (10 bar). Resin glass. Official Casio India MRP: ₹4,495 (inclusive of taxes).
